abstentionRules: Abstain when meaning is ambiguous, unsupported, ungrounded, or requires invented protocol symbols.
Retain source text and provenance even when candidate semantics are rejected.
Caller confidence never promotes a candidate.
canonicalRules: Use only registered protocol symbols or explicit x- extensions.
Use the canonical frame roles exactly; unexpected roles fail exact identity.
deadline encodes time in roles.time, not clause.time.
conditions and consequences are clause arrays, not role lookalikes.
negated is compositional: lexical prohibit/allow use negated=false; negated=true means NOT that predicate; never infer not prohibited == allowed.

fieldSemantics.kind: semantic clause kind from the protocol registry (for example preference)
fieldSemantics.roles: object mapping canonical role names to typed LunumTerm objects; never a comma-separated list
fieldSemantics.world: semantic world from the protocol registry (for example real); never a language tag

frameFirst.framePromptBlock:
prefer(experiencer, theme; experiencer: actor|entity|system) — An experiencer has a preference for a theme.
send(agent, object; optional: recipient, destination; recipient|destination (mutually exclusive); agent: actor|entity|system; recipient: actor|entity|system) — An agent transmits an object to a recipient or destination.
receive(recipient, theme; optional: source; recipient: actor|entity|system) — A recipient accepts or receives a theme from a source.
believe(experiencer, theme; experiencer: actor|entity|system) — An experiencer holds a belief regarding a theme or proposition.
publish(agent, theme; optional: audience; agent: actor|entity|system) — An agent makes a theme available to an audience or public.
retry(agent; optional: count, theme; at least one of: count|theme; agent: actor|entity|system; count: quantity) — An agent attempts an action again, with a count or action theme.
request(agent, theme; optional: recipient; agent: actor|entity|system; recipient: actor|entity|system) — An agent requests a theme or action from an optional recipient.
keep(no required roles; optional: agent, theme, visibility; at least one of: theme|visibility; agent: actor|entity|system) — An agent retains a theme, optionally with an explicit visibility.
delete(no required roles; optional: agent, theme, object, target; theme|object|target (mutually exclusive); agent: actor|entity|system) — An agent removes or deletes an object/theme/target.
enable(theme; optional: agent; agent: actor|entity|system) — An agent enables a feature, system, or capability.
disable(theme; optional: agent; agent: actor|entity|system) — An agent disables a feature, system, or capability.
allow(agent, theme; optional: recipient; agent: actor|entity|system; recipient: actor|entity|system) — An agent permits a recipient to perform an action or access a theme.
prohibit(agent, theme; optional: recipient; agent: actor|entity|system; recipient: actor|entity|system) — An agent forbids a recipient from performing an action or accessing a theme.
deploy(agent, destination; agent: actor|entity|system) — An agent deploys to an environment or destination.
copy(agent, source, destination; agent: actor|entity|system) — An agent copies a resource from source to destination.
rotate(agent, theme; agent: actor|entity|system) — An agent rotates a credential or key.
deadline(subject, time) — A subject has a deadline at time.
below(subject, value) — A metric or subject is below a threshold or value.
above(subject, value) — A metric or subject is above a threshold or value.
before(subject, object) — A subject event precedes an object event.
after(subject, object) — A subject event follows an object event.
confirmed(no required roles; optional: agent, theme; at least one of: agent|theme; agent: actor|entity|system) — An action or transaction is confirmed by an agent or for a theme.
confirm(no required roles; optional: agent, theme; at least one of: agent|theme; agent: actor|entity|system) — An agent confirms an action or transaction.
frameFirst.roleValues: Use typed LunumTerm objects with the field name type (never termType). Identifier terms use id or ref; literal terms use value. The builder rejects missing or disallowed types, missing required roles, extra roles, and exclusive-role conflicts.
frameFirst.unframedBehavior: lunum_build_candidate rejects registered-but-unframed predicates; submitCandidate remains available for candidate-only abstention.

frames.unframedBehavior: candidate-only; abstain in exact-identity extraction; no lfp:2.1

grounding.identityBehavior: agent proposals receive deterministic gnd keys for evidence only; unresolved proposals remain grounding-pending and cannot grant lfp:2.1

groundingRules: Open instance identifiers remain data and are never inferred equivalent.
A semantic reference requires ref or id; surface-evidence references do not establish identity.
Ungrounded or unresolved references fail closed for exact identity.
